defensiveAbilities.name: Exploding Guts
defensiveAbilities.description:
When the rakkatak is critically hit or critically fails a Fortitude save, one of its organs bursts. Roll 1d4 to determine what effect this has.

1 Trapped noxious gas rushes out. The rakkatak is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the triggering attack or effect.

2 Pus showers those nearby. Each creature in a 5ft Emanation is Sickened 1.

3 The damage is severe. The rakkatak takes 1d6 Persistent,bleed Damage damage.

4 Gelatinous rakkatak eggs explode forth and instantly hatch. Each creature in a 5ft Emanation takes 1d6 Persistent,piercing Damage damage from the ravenous larvae.

offensiveAbilities.name: Predator's Stare
offensiveAbilities.description: The rakkatak turns its grotesque yet mesmerizing eyes upon one creature it can see within 30 feet. That creature must succeed at a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save or become Fascinated with the rakkatak. While fascinated, the creature must spend at least 1 action each round moving closer to the rakkatak as expediently as possible, and can't intentionally move away from it. The fascination ends after 1 minute or when the rakkatak uses Predator's Stare again, whichever comes first.

offensiveAbilities.name: Suck Innards
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements A Grabbed, Paralyzed, Restrained, Unconscious, or willing creature is within the rakkatak's reach

Effect The rakkatak deals 3d6 Untyped Damage damage to the target (Basic DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save). If the creature takes at least 12 damage, the rakkatak regains 10 Healing Damage HP.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
